634:t_4:37.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. It is as vast and great as its name suggests.」

634:t_4:38.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$... $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$... You two are the forerunners of a new era.」

634:t_4:39.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now that the Empire has gone, and Earth and space have begun to move toward true harmony, the world will enter a new era.」

634:t_4:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And what awaits beyond that is...」

634:t_4:41.en:
$$シモン$$
「A battle with the galaxy as its stage, huh...」

634:t_4:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go home for now. Back to the Earth we protected.」

634:t_4:43.en:
$n
「Let's rest, just for a little while. Just a little, until the next battle begins...」

634:t_4:45.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ came together and turned into a flower, and...」

634:t_4:46.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Are you saying they wrapped up the black hole...!?」

634:t_4:47.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ understood us, and saved the Earth.」

634:t_4:49.en:
$$シモン$$
「Something that beautiful was born. The fighting's over now, isn't it.」

634:t_4:50.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「In that moment, I touched the consciousness of the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too.」

634:t_4:51.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Their home planet was about to die, and they were searching for a way to survive...」

634:t_4:52.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ don't have a will in each individual; the whole swarm has a single will, doesn't it...」

634:t_4:53.en:
$$シャア$$
「They were connected through $$脳量子波$$ and kept the whole swarm in order.」

634:t_4:54.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then they attacked people with $$脳量子波$$ because they were trying to communicate...」

634:t_4:55.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By connecting... by becoming one, they were trying to understand each other, weren't they...」

634:t_4:56.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The reason we were able to coexist with the $$バジュラ$$ must be that their ecology was similar.」

634:t_4:57.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And now... they've come to understand humanity.」

634:t_4:60.en:
$$シン$$
「Yes! It's the flower $$マリナ$$ gave to $$刹那$$!」

634:t_4:61.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「By sharing consciousness with $$刹那$$, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ gave form to the image of peace inside him.」

634:t_4:62.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But $$刹那$$ and $$ヒイロ$$ are...」

634:t_4:64.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Look, everyone! The middle of the flower!」

634:t_4:65.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I've confirmed the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ and the $$ウイングゼロ$$! Both units are safe!」

634:t_4:68.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You're one tough guy, $$ヒイロ$$!」

634:t_4:70.en:
$$五飛$$
「Even so, that guy did well to take in an $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will that would destroy even $$刹那$$'s mind.」

634:t_4:71.en:
$$カトル$$
「So he had the Heart of Space after all.」

634:t_4:73.en:
$$カトル$$
「The Heart of Space... It's a phrase the leader $$ヒイロ・ユイ#pilot$$ used, something people need in order to live in this universe.」

634:t_4:74.en:
$$カトル$$
「There are many interpretations, but I think it's a heart that understands others and accepts them.」

634:t_4:75.en:
$$タケル$$
「If people could do that, there'd be no more conflict.」

634:t_4:77.en:
$$カトル$$
「Yes. It is as vast and great as its name suggests.」

634:t_4:78.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Major $$グラハム$$... The future you protected with your life has blossomed like this.)

634:t_4:79.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
(Leave the rest to us. Rest in peace, eternal Top Gun...)

634:t_4:80.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now that the Empire has gone, and Earth and space have begun to move toward true harmony, the world will enter a new era.」

634:t_4:81.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And what awaits beyond that is...」

634:t_4:82.en:
$$シモン$$
「A battle with the galaxy as its stage, huh...」

634:t_4:83.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's go home for now. Back to the Earth we protected.」

634:t_4:84.en:
$n
「Let's rest, just for a little while. Just a little, until the next battle begins...」

634:t_4:89.en:
???
「...To think they'd make peace with the writhing metal.」

634:t_4:90.en:
???
「See, isn't it amazing? No matter what we send in, they find a way to handle it, so watching them is thrilling.」

634:t_4:91.en:
???
「Sooner or later they will go beyond evolution, to $$シンカ$$... But the radiance of the sun cannot be permitted.」

634:t_4:92.en:
???
「So what are you going to do?」

634:t_4:93.en:
???
「Isn't it obvious? The Earthlings of that world are to be erased.」

634:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Especially you, Mr. $$グラハム$$... Allow me to praise you for overturning your fate.」

634:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That life-or-death battle produced, no less, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 1500 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

634:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To live is to fight... The name $$ミスター・ブシドー$$ has become completely a thing of the past now, hasn't it.」

634:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Your battle, fought with your life on the line, carved out humanity's future.)

634:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 1000 Z that it produced... I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

634:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The future of humanity that you hoped for... We swear to your soul that we will keep protecting it, without fail.)

634:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, that settles the $$地球圏$$ for the time being.」

634:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, this peace is only temporary, and those who have their sights on Earth are still alive and well.」

634:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The army of darkness, $$ミケーネ$$, the $$堕天翅$$, $$ガイゾック$$, the $$バジュラ$$, the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s, the $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

634:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And then there are the $$サイデリアル$$ and the fundamental calamity...」

634:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Will humanity truly survive and be able to grasp its future, I wonder...」

634:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! Even if it's only temporary, here I go, pouring cold water on your peaceful time and what have you!」

634:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, business as usual today too! Business, business!」

635:t_001:1.en:
$$カティ$$
「Even an $$イノベイター$$ can't turn this situation around!」

635:t_002:1.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「Our strength in this sector is down to 20%! Other sectors have also dropped below 50%!」

635:t_002:2.en:
$$カティ$$
「Is this as far as we go...!」

635:t_002:3.en:
$$カティ$$
(If the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ attack had come one more month later, that plan might have been ready in time...!)

635:t_002:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「Regrettably, we fall back! Notify $$ネオ・ジオン$$ as well!」
